name: Gemini Image Tools
description: AI image generation, editing, and analysis tools powered by Google Gemini (Nano Banana 2)

tools.name: Generate Image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Google Gemini's image generation models (Nano Banana 2). Returns a base64-encoded image and stores it via the files service.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate. Be specific about style, subject, lighting, composition.

model.description: Gemini model to use. 'flash' = gemini-2.5-flash-image (fast, default)

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio — REQUIRED. Choose based on use case: 16:9 for hero/banner/landscape, 1:1 for social/avatar/square, 9:16 for stories/portrait/mobile, 3:2 for standard photo, 21:9 for cinematic/ultra-wide. Always ask the user or infer from context — never assume square.

person_generation.description: Whether to allow generation of images containing people

temperature.description: Controls randomness (0.0-2.0). Lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative

file_url.description: URL to access the stored image

instructions.summary: Generate images from text descriptions using Gemini AI
when_to_use: User asks to generate, create, or make an image
User describes a visual they want created
User asks for a logo, illustration, photo, artwork, or diagram
when_not_to_use: User wants to edit an existing image (use gemini_image.edit)
User wants to analyze or describe an image (use gemini_image.describe)
User wants screenshots of the dashboard (use screencap tools)

tools.name: Edit Image
tools.description: Edit an existing image using text instructions. Provide the source image as base64 or URL along with editing instructions.

prompt.description: Instructions for how to edit the image (e.g., 'remove the background', 'change the sky to sunset', 'add a hat to the person')

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded source image to edit. Provide either this or image_url.

image_url.description: URL of the source image to edit. Provide either this or image_base64.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output image

instructions.summary: Edit existing images with text instructions using Gemini AI
when_to_use: User wants to modify, edit, or transform an existing image
User provides an image and asks to change something about it
User asks to remove backgrounds, add elements, change colors, or restyle
when_not_to_use: User wants a new image from scratch (use gemini_image.generate)
User only wants to analyze an image (use gemini_image.describe)

tools.name: Describe Image
tools.description: Analyze and describe an image using Gemini's vision capabilities. Can answer questions about image content, identify objects, read text, and provide detailed descriptions.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image to analyze. Provide either this or image_url.

image_url.description: URL of the image to analyze. Provide either this or image_url.

prompt.description: Question or instruction about the image (e.g., 'What text is in this image?', 'Identify all objects')

instructions.summary: Analyze images using Gemini's vision capabilities
when_to_use: User asks to describe, analyze, or explain an image
User wants to identify objects, text, or elements in an image
User asks 'what is in this image?' or 'what does this show?'
when_not_to_use: User wants to generate a new image (use gemini_image.generate)
User wants to edit an image (use gemini_image.edit)

tools.name: List Image Models
tools.description: List available Gemini image generation models with their capabilities, pricing, and supported features.

instructions.summary: Show available Gemini image models and their capabilities
when_to_use: User asks what image models are available
User wants to know pricing or capabilities
User asks which model to use

instructions.summary: Generate, edit, and analyze images using Google Gemini AI models
when_to_use: User wants to create images from text descriptions
User wants to edit or transform existing images
User wants to analyze or describe images
User asks about image generation capabilities
when_not_to_use: User wants dashboard screenshots (use screencap tools)
User wants to browse or manage files (use file tools)

typical_workflow: 1. gemini_image.generate(prompt) — Create an image from text
